k0.root_cause: Since ADR-135 the acknowledgement and the design start together; a Core killed between the plan's claim (canva_design_plans 'planning') and the admission of its paid call left a claim resume() never dispatched, so the design run ended DESIGN_PLANNING after 30 polls.
k0.fix: resume() (and a same-key generate) carries a claim with no admission row on: inputs must hash to the claim; the call is admitted under the plan id in the usual locked transaction (at most one admission); changed inputs or a blocked task fail with nothing spent; an admitted call is never re-sent (ADR-101).
